From soil to oil

One farm, one team

Pressure is an entirely organic, single-source farm. We grow 100% for rosin, and every step we take is made with the end product, the jar, in mind.

We're legacy cannabis growers who dedicated our lives to this plant before it was an industry. We know quality, and our jars and our price point prove it.

The truth

We're single source because it's the only way to guarantee what goes in your jar. Not all single source is equal: some companies only wash flower that didn't make their flower grade, and others use pesticides, synthetics or salts.

Companies that wash other farms' material can't make the guarantees we can. We know exactly how every plant was grown and what it was treated with.

  1. Native soilOrganic amendments in native New Mexico soil
  2. GeneticsSelected for rosin, fed with clean water
  3. Nothing addedNo pesticides, no synthetics, no salts
  4. Full termHarvested with care, never pulled early for a lighter color
  5. All on siteFrozen, washed, pressed and jarred on the farm
  6. Real QCChecked by real hash heads, priced for real consumers
Follow @pressure.nm for new drops and restocks.For use only by adults 21 and older. Keep out of reach of children. Pressure products are sold only through licensed New Mexico retailers.
